model_annotation: The chart compares the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four sectors: industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021. The chart consists of three donut charts, each representing one of the three categories, and is accompanied by a legend that maps the colors to the respective sectors. Each chart is divided into four slices, corresponding to the four sectors, and displays the percentage and absolute value for each category. The "Number of Enterprises" chart shows that "Other Services" accounts for 61% (19.0 million), "Construction" for 19% (5.9 million), "Trade" for 12% (3.7 million), and "Industry" for 8% (2.4 million). The "Number of Persons Employed" chart indicates that "Other Services" makes up 51% (80.2 million), "Trade" accounts for 21% (33.0 million), "Industry" for 19% (29.5 million), and "Construction" for 9% (13.4 million). The "Turnover" chart reveals that "Other Services" constitutes 33% (10.6 trillion), "Industry" accounts for 31% (9.9 trillion), "Trade" makes up 31% (9.8 trillion), and "Construction" for 6% (1.9 trillion). The charts are visually consistent, with the same color scheme and ordering of the slices, and the legend is provided below the charts to facilitate understanding.
